Everything is roasted to order for the web shop and ships Monday and Thursday. Subscriptions run every two or four weeks and can be paused any time from your account.

Ten minutes, watched the whole way

Every batch runs against a logged profile. If the curve drifts, the batch goes to staff coffee instead of your bag. Here's how a House Blend run reads.

  1. 0:00 Charge at 195°C Green coffee drops into a preheated drum and the temperature dives.
  2. 8:30 First crack Sugars caramelise and the beans audibly split. Airflow opens up.
  3. 10:20 Drop at 205°C Out to the cooling tray, stirred by hand, bagged once it's at room temperature.

Good coffee, consistently, without the drama

Fixed profiles per lot, standing delivery days, and someone who picks up the phone when the espresso starts running fast.

The market brew bar

We pour the current lineup every weekend at the farmers market, and you can take a bag home while it's still warm from Friday's drum.

Sundays, April through November

Roastery pickup

Order online, skip the shipping, and collect on a roast day. Come by mid-run and you can watch the batch you're taking home come off the drum.

Tuesdays & Fridays, by appointment

Let's talk coffee

Wholesale enquiries, subscription changes, or just wondering what's on the cupping table this week. We answer everything ourselves, usually the same day.
